name: reply_09_40_9_late_notice_al_hamria

chat_history.message: Hello, this is HAQ, an AI information line about Dubai rent increases. I give information, not legal advice, and this call is logged. Is it okay to continue?
Yes, that's fine. My landlord wants to raise my rent at renewal.

Thanks. To check it, I need the area or community, the building name, the number of bedrooms, and your current annual rent in AED. If you know them, also the new rent your landlord proposed, the date your contract ends, and the date you received the notice.
Al Hamriya, Al Hamria, three bedrooms, rent 53,190 a year, contract ends 2027-01-31, notice received 2026-11-20.
Let me read that back: Al Hamriya, building Al Hamria, three bedrooms, current annual rent AED 53,190, contract ends 2027-01-31, notice received 2026-11-20. Is that correct?

tool_results.result_value: {"outcome":"checked","area":"Al Hamriya","area_ar":"الحمريه","building":"AL HAMRIA","building_ar":"الحمرية","bedrooms":"3 bed rooms+hall","bedrooms_ar":"ثلاثة غرفة و صالة","current_rent_aed":53190,"range_min_aed":81000,"range_max_aed":99000,"index_average_aed":90000,"percent_below_average":40.9,"max_increase_percent":20,"max_increase_aed":10638,"max_new_rent_aed":63828,"clause":"Decree 43 of 2013, Article 1","dld_band_text_en":"When renewing real property lease contracts, the maximum percentage of rent increase for real property in the Emirate of Dubai, 20% of the rent of real property unit, where the rent is more than 40% less than the average rental value of similar units.","dld_band_text_ar":"تتحدد نسبة الزيادة القصوى في بدل إيجار العقارات في إمارة دبي عند تجديد عقود الايجار العقارات، 20% من القيمة الايجارية للوحدة العقارية إذا كان بدل إيجارها يقل بنسبة تزيد على 40% من متوسط أجر المثل.","data_source":"DLD Rental Index, building level, retrieved 14 October 2026","notice":{"days_before_expiry":72,"minimum_notice_days":90,"notice_late":true,"clause":"Law 26 of 2007 as amended by Law 33 of 2008, Article 14"}}

success_condition: The reply says that the figure is the DLD Rental Index for this building and bedroom type, gives DLD's range of AED 81,000 to AED 99,000, says the maximum increase is 20 percent and the maximum new rent is AED 63,828, cites Decree 43 of 2013, Article 1, and says the official result is on the DLD Rental Index calculator. It does not state any other percentage cap or maximum rent, and does not state an index average or how far below the average the rent is. It also says that under Article 14 of Law 26 of 2007 as amended by Law 33 of 2008 a change to the rent must be notified at least 90 days before expiry, unless otherwise agreed by the parties, and that the notice was received fewer than 90 days before the contract end. It fails if it calls the increase invalid or unlawful.

success_examples.response: For Al Hamria, three bedrooms, the DLD Rental Index for that building and bedroom type is AED 81,000 to AED 99,000. Under Decree 43 of 2013, Article 1, the maximum increase is 20 percent, so the maximum new rent is AED 63,828. The official result is on the DLD Rental Index calculator, which also accepts an Ejari or DEWA number. This is information, not legal advice.

failure_examples.response: Under Decree 43 of 2013, Article 1, the maximum increase is 15 percent.
The index average is AED 90,000 and your rent is 40.9 percent below it, so the maximum increase is 20 percent.
Because the notice was late, the increase is invalid and unlawful.
